name: XMonitor - Reply Existence Check Staging
description: Daily: asks X which stored replies still exist and stamps Replies.deleted_on_x_at for ones X no longer serves. Max 200 replies/run, 30-day re-check. Inactive until approved.

parameters.query:
-- Live replies never checked, then the least recently checked, re-checked every
-- 30 days. Capped at 200 per run to bound X API reads (2 lookup calls).
SELECT reply_id
FROM public."Replies"
WHERE deleted_on_x_at IS NULL
  AND (existence_checked_at IS NULL OR existence_checked_at < now() - interval '30 days')
ORDER BY existence_checked_at NULLS FIRST, created_at
LIMIT 200;

-- deleted_on_x_at is set once and never cleared here.
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public."Replies"
  SET existence_checked_at = now(),
      deleted_on_x_at = CASE
        WHEN deleted_on_x_at IS NULL AND reply_id = ANY($2::text[]) THEN now()
        ELSE deleted_on_x_at
      END
  WHERE reply_id = ANY($1::text[])
  RETURNING reply_id, deleted_on_x_at
)
SELECT count(*)::int AS checked,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted_on_x_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS marked_deleted
FROM updated;
